item.description:
Austinato – Goblin Live In Austin, Texas was shot on the third leg of the band's North American tour at the Mohawk venue in 2014. Classical rock outfit Goblin have scored multiple Italian horror films and toured for more than 40 years. The lineup features Massimo Morante?, Maurizio Guarini?, Fabio Pignatelli? and Agostino Marangolo.
